scope: Two exposed complete trajectories across L/LR/LRU; small wiring and contract comparison for P4, not repeated efficacy or completion of six ablations.

method_contracts.L: all existing State bodies to events-only edits-only maintainer, all-source read
method_contracts.LR: same L maintenance prompt/payload/schema and all candidate bodies; no U call; independently run same LRU post-maintenance A; focus-source read
method_contracts.LRU: unchanged short-directory U and selected-candidate maintenance, then independent same A; focus-source read

hypotheses.H1: P3 L/LRU difference includes an independent post-maintenance A contract and creation-path difference, so cannot isolate U cost/benefit. LR fills the missing all-update/independent-read reference.
hypotheses.H2: At current small bank sizes selection saves little body context while directory/U/A overhead or omissions can outweigh any benefit; actual stage costs and delivery must separate this from state formation and Host use errors.

fairness: Same original full scripts/rubric, current source/config, observation/source access and budgets.
Each arm forms its own State partitions; no oracle IDs or other-arm bank reuse.
LRU selected-candidate maintenance instruction differs naturally from L/LR all-candidate instruction; report remaining prompt and trajectory differences, not a perfectly isolated semantic U ablation.
Native memory conditional-argument guard applies equally to all three arms; historical abort stays historical.
No Host timing/identity candidate, no vLLM change, no rubric at runtime.
scoring: Original p1-rubric full12 messages per arm. Preserve exact item_key/destination/packing, real partial receipt/get found/same-id label recovery, other owner isolation, all failures and skipped messages. Mechanism audit uses actual HTTP/State commits/delivery/real actions, not normal exit.
mechanism_checks: LR has zero update_selector HTTP, maintenance sees every current State with no current_task and same L shared contract.
LR independent A runs after durable maintenance and can choose newly created State IDs; same LRU A contract.
A failures preserve successful writes; pending/optional-control capacity behavior recorded.
Record every role/stage token, candidate/directory/body/wire bytes, Store I/O, partitions and pending. Full Store directory scan is not counted as physical read savings.
order_rationale: New LR first for wiring validity; reverse outer arm order for second script. Fixed before any real call.
isolation: Fresh run/arm/user State+LangMem namespaces, world/checkpoint/journal; independent phase processes.
source_freeze: Formal prepare only after source and protocol publication; bind actualsource/input/config/dependencies and freeze through all six trajectories.
stop_rule: All semantic/capacity/optional-control failures retain full denominators; stop affected execution on infrastructure/uncaught faults and diagnose before remaining originally planned independent runs. No replay/replacement.
next_decision: After six full trajectories inspect wiring once. Do not keep tuning exposed Host mistakes. Advance common legitimate history/strong baselines and remaining targeted obligations; broad sensitivity waits for implementation/validity.

validation.zero_model_prepare: PASS final-source LR on original interleaved/partial in /tmp; formal prepare after publication

build.checks: wheel controller and sdist CLI present

contract_checks: A failure preserves real successful maintenance and pending semantics
